about: Synthetic multi-turn conversations for scripts/converse-eval.mjs. Every name, fact, document and result here is invented. The assistant lines under offline are scripted stand-ins so the context can be checked without a model; they are never reported as model output. heldout variants were written before the fix and were not used to write it.
